name: Nginx Proxy Manager
short_description: Easy-to-use reverse proxy with free SSL certificate management.
description: Nginx Proxy Manager provides a beautiful web UI to manage Nginx reverse proxy hosts with automatic Let's Encrypt SSL certificates. Expose self-hosted services securely over the internet with custom domains, access lists, and advanced Nginx configuration — no command-line needed.
usecases: Expose self-hosted services via custom subdomains with HTTPS.
Automatically obtain and renew Let's Encrypt SSL certificates.
Manage reverse proxy rules, redirects, and access lists from a web UI.
notes: Default admin credentials: admin@example.com / changeme — change immediately after first login.
Port 80 and 443 must be reachable from the internet for Let's Encrypt validation.
